ratings.reason: The cluster detail combines an aggregate GPT summary with the original responses and follow-up evidence behind it. This strongly fits overview-to-cases, but the quote does not explain how users select clusters or whether a coarse cluster overview remains visible; impact and novelty are therefore judged conservatively.

This is an unusually clean, rebuildable instance: selecting an entity in an aggregate distribution highlights it and filters the table to matching individual examples. The mechanism transfers directly to many collections, though linked chart-to-table filtering is established rather than novel.

The thematic overview aggregates facts into clusters; selecting a cluster makes its detailed facts available in the Story View. The levels, aggregation relation, navigation, and resulting population are all explicit and broadly reusable.

Topic, post, and comment levels plausibly form a useful aggregation hierarchy. However, the caption only names the levels; it does not say what appears at each level or whether selecting a topic or post defines the finer population.

The design goal directly connects aggregate results, filtered subsets, and individual examples, which is central to the pattern and highly transferable. It remains a goal-level description rather than a rebuildable account of the visible views and selection behavior.

Showing child summaries at a section node provides a coarse representation that helps users choose finer nodes. The evidence describes hierarchical targeting, but not a simultaneous overview/detail arrangement or an explicit coarse-selection filter over individual cases.

Groups and individual messages establish two granularities over one conversation collection. The quote does not specify how groups summarize messages, how a group is selected, or how that selection constrains the individual-message view.

Users click a sentiment category and receive exactly the diary entries associated with it, making the coarse-to-fine filtering mechanism highly reproducible. The quote does not establish a substantive aggregate summary beyond the categories, and category-to-list drill-down is conventional.

Clicking a high-level module to explore its internals is a concrete drill-down through an asymmetric code hierarchy. It clearly supports orientation in large codebases, although the evidence does not establish whether the high-level visualization computes an aggregate summary of many underlying items.

A graph presents the story-chunk collection as a structural overview, and selecting a chunk opens its expanded detail. Both views and the selection response are explicit and readily transferable, though the interaction is a standard overview-detail implementation.

Overview-detail interfaces are the stated subject, and the quote cleanly identifies a collection overview paired with the selected item's detail. Generalizability is exceptional, but the supplied evidence does not describe Meridian's concrete malleability mechanics or demonstrate outcome impact.

Selecting a student to reveal details is compatible with master-detail interaction, but the evidence never describes an aggregate or summary view over the student collection. Impact and the exact relationship between levels cannot be established from the supplied sentence.

The paper explicitly centers the pattern and defines its asymmetric collection-overview and selected-item-detail views. The title suggests a potentially non-obvious malleability contribution, but the provided quote does not expose that mechanism or enough evidence to score impact above ordinary.

It directly pairs a visual aggregate of side-by-side ratings with inspection of the corresponding individual examples. This is a strong, transferable verification workflow, although the exact selection gesture and layout are not stated.

An insight overview with details on demand and supporting evidence is concrete and useful for verification. Fit is imperfect because the quote does not establish that the overview is an aggregate function of underlying cases or that selecting an overview population filters a finer collection.

Group, conversation, and turn levels form a clear three-stage aggregation hierarchy for discovering jailbreak behavior, with meaningful safety implications. The evidence does not specify the selection transitions, filtering behavior, or on-screen relationship among the levels.

Summary, instance, and candidate levels suggest multi-resolution inspection of a model decision process. The quote does not explain what users select, how a coarser selection determines finer contents, or whether these levels cover the same collection; transfer is also tied to the OpenQA pipeline.

A subset-level summary paired with an instance view is directionally consistent with the pattern. The evidence is truncated before describing the Instance View and provides no selection or filtering behavior, so mechanism, impact, and novelty are not safely judgeable.

The interface deliberately begins with an integrated case overview while retaining access to the modality-level evidence beneath it. This is a consequential verification move in clinical work, though the quote does not specify the selection gesture or whether selecting part of the summary filters the evidence shown.

The caption names a Gantt overview of test results and a detail view, but it is truncated before identifying the detailed object or the linkage between views. Aggregation, selection, and practical effect cannot be established from the available evidence.

Clicking a plot in the global Matrix View opens its Single View, giving a precise and reproducible coarse-to-fine transition. The quote does not fully establish whether each plot aggregates many comparable attention items, but the global-to-single relationship is strong.

A button on the L1 insight opens a drill-down panel exposing the underlying patient data, clearly connecting summary and evidence. It is highly actionable in a clinical setting and easy to rebuild, although summary-to-panel drill-down itself is conventional.

Selecting students or tasks to inspect their conversations clearly defines a finer population from a coarse choice. The quote omits what aggregate information precedes the choice and how the resulting conversations are represented, limiting confidence in the full structural signature.

Themes organize the anecdote collection coarsely and are paired with the source quotations that substantiate each theme. This exposes cases behind synthesis, but the quote describes presentation rather than an explicit selection-driven overview-to-detail interaction.

Chapter- and scene-level exploration supplies asymmetric granularities over one story. The evidence states the levels but not how chapter summaries aggregate scenes, how users move between them, or whether a chapter selection determines the scene population.

Moving between cross-task comparisons and individual code lines could support strong aggregate-to-case evaluation. The quote only states that multiple granularities exist; it does not identify the views, interaction, or coarse selection that defines finer contents.

High-level performance and fine-grained retrieval-generation diagnostics establish analytical scale, but not necessarily aggregation levels over the same collection. No selection-to-filter mechanism or individual case behind an aggregate is described, so this is closer to generic multi-level analysis.

The scatterplot and layered axes support pattern discovery while the same interface permits instance inspection, matching aggregate-to-case analysis. The evidence does not state what a user selects or how that choice populates the instance view.

Scatterplot, critical-issue, and detailed-issue views plausibly form a three-level exploration path. The caption merely inventories panels and does not show their aggregation relation, selection linkage, or resulting filtered population.

The supplied quote describes hierarchical concept/code organization and an image grid, but it provides no aggregate overview, selected population, detail view, or individual case behind an aggregate. On the available evidence, it does not support assignment to this pattern.
ratings.disqualify_reason: The evidence quote does not demonstrate Overview-plus-Detail's aggregation-and-selection structure at all.
